## FieldPlan interface

One field of a record plan.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface FieldPlan
```

## Remarks

Presence and value domain are separate axes: an optional field may still be nullable (its `value` is a `nullable` plan), and a required field may be nullable too. An absent optional field is omitted, never encoded as `null`<!-- -->.
